title: Recast the Past: Stable Long Video Generation with Full Context Memory
abstract: arXiv:2610.27986v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-horizon video generation requires retaining an ever-expanding history, but conditioning on its growing token sequence is costly. Existing methods restrict or compress historical context, potentially losing information needed for future generation. This work proposes ReCam, which groups local spatiotemporal blocks of historical latents into vectors and projects them directly into the high-dimensional hidden space of a Diffusion Transformer. The model learns to use the resulting memory tokens through native self-attention, reducing token count while retaining block-level access to the full history. To mitigate temporal drift during autoregressive rollout, we further introduce dual-pointer denoising with separate noise schedules for recent context and target frames. Among the evaluated methods, ReCam achieves the highest VBench-Long overall score of 80.1 and competitive static-scene revisitation performance on R2M-Bench. It also lead

translated_title: 重塑过去：基于完整上下文记忆的稳定长视频生成
translated_abstract: 长时程视频生成需要保留不断扩展的历史信息，但以不断增长的token序列作为条件来生成，代价十分高昂。现有方法通过限制或压缩历史上下文，可能丢失未来生成所需的信息。本工作提出ReCam，将历史潜表示的局部时空块分组为向量，并直接投影到扩散Transformer的高维隐空间中。模型通过原生自注意力机制学习使用由此得到的记忆token，在减少token数量的同时保留对完整历史的块级访问。为缓解自回归生成过程中的时间漂移，我们进一步引入双指针去噪方法，为近期上下文和目标帧设置独立的噪声调度。在所评估的方法中，ReCam取得了最高的VBench-Long总分80.1，并在R2M-Bench上展现出具有竞争力的静态场景重访性能。
tldr: 提出ReCam方法，将历史时空块投影为记忆token并通过原生自注意力访问完整历史，结合双指针去噪缓解时间漂移，在降低计算开销的同时实现稳定长视频生成，取得VBench-Long最高分80.1。
en_tdlr: Proposes ReCam, which groups historical spatiotemporal blocks into memory tokens accessed via native self-attention and introduces dual-pointer denoising to mitigate temporal drift, enabling stable long video generation with full context memory and achieving the highest VBench-Long score of 80.1.
